# k6 export samples

Generated by `k6 v2.2.0 (commit/00a9a1b7f5, go1.26.5, linux/arm64)` with one VU and four HTTP iterations against a
local stdlib HTTP server: three HTTP 200 responses and one HTTP 500 response.
`summary-export.json` uses `--summary-export`; `handle-summary.json` saves the
argument supplied to `handleSummary`. Both must report four requests and 25% failures.
No external service was used.
